phase: Active MDL after first bellwether verdict
phaseDetail: The jury returned a defense verdict in Rickard on February 3, 2026. The September JPML report lists 4,185 pending MDL-2974 actions before Judge Leigh Martin May. The public court orders reviewed did not verify a later trial setting, so this guide does not describe earlier 2026 trial plans as upcoming.

settlements.label: Global settlement status
settlements.detail: The Northern District of Georgia public MDL page and posted orders reviewed on September 14, 2026 did not identify a global settlement program. The Rickard verdict resolves the trial issues in that individual case; it does not determine the outcome or value of other claims.
settlements.individualClaims: No individual payment schedule or official payout grid verified.

updates.summary: JPML reports 4,185 pending actions and 4,503 historical actions in MDL-2974.
Pending actions increased by 29 from 4,156 on August 3, 2026. This is a net docket change, not a count of new claims.
The Rickard jury verdict was filed in favor of the defense. It does not decide other plaintiffs’ claims.
